_README: PRD 8.1: 'Computed bill matches 5 real TANGEDCO bills TO THE RUPEE -- most
falsifiable component, must be exact.'
tests/test_tariff_golden.py FAILS until this file holds 5 real bills.
That failure is deliberate. It is the forcing function: the tariff engine is
the highest value-per-hour item in the build (PRD 7 item 3) and it is also
the only component a judge can check with a phone and a paper bill.
HOW TO FILL THIS IN
1. Get 5 real TANGEDCO domestic bills. Different consumption levels --
include at least one under 100 units (the free-slab case, demo beat 2)
and one over 400 (the top-slab case).
2. For each, record units consumed and the energy charge in rupees.
3. STRIP PII BEFORE COMMITTING (NFR-1). No name, no address, no CSN.
Use a made-up label. Never commit a photo of a bill.
4. Set billing_period_months to what the bill actually covers. TN bills
BIMONTHLY -- see PRD 8.2. If your bills are bimonthly you cannot use
the monthly-equivalent schedule directly; that open question has to be
resolved first, and resolving it is what these bills are for.
FIELD NOTES
units_kwh        -- consumption billed in the period
energy_charge_inr-- the SLAB charge only. Exclude fixed charges, meter
rent, electricity duty and any subsidy line. The
engine models slabs, so compare against slabs.
expect_exact     -- true once you have confirmed the number is the slab
charge and nothing else. Bills that are still
ambiguous stay false and are reported, not asserted.
